_desc: Phase-4 distributed liveness GOSSIP gate — a node reroutes off a dead relay using ANOTHER node's gossip, WITHOUT its own timeout evidence (the mesh converges, not just the failing node). carol is MOBILE so it advertises NO routes -> alice can never route through carol -> carol has ZERO first-hand evidence about relay; any reroute it makes is provably GOSSIP-driven. Topology: alice + carol both reach dest via relay (their primary); carol also has an ALT to dest via dave. relay DEPARTS (forced_drops kill EVERY relay->alice and relay->carol frame from the 4th occurrence — after the first 3 beacons establish dest-via-relay on both). alice sends dest a stream of DMs: RTS-to-relay times out (relay silent to alice) -> alice marks relay SUSPECT from FIRST-HAND rts_timeout evidence -> alice GOSSIPS relay in its BCN suspect-TLV (alice-carol link is up). carol hears alice's gossip and marks relay suspect as a REMOTE observation (peer_suspect_mark remote_src=alice=1, source=bcn_suspect) -> the 12 dB penalty REROUTES carol's dest route from relay to dave (rt_penalty_rerank reason=bcn_suspect, from_next=relay to_next=dave) — with NO send of its own. A later carol DM then DELIVERS via the rerouted dave path. Pre-Phase-4 carol would keep relay as primary until its OWN flights timed out. Asserts: carol peer_suspect_mark remote_src:1 (gossip received) + carol rt_penalty_rerank reason:bcn_suspect (gossip-DRIVEN reroute, not first-hand) + dest delivered m1 (end-to-end via dave). Idle + lossless otherwise (sigma_db=0).
